text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen—a race that holds a special meaning for Maruzensky. It's said that if she'd entered, she might have found a new archrival there…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But now, Sakura Chiyono O proudly declares that she's Maruzensky's rival. She's overflowing with passion as she readies for the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When she enters the paddock, she's surprised to see Mr. C.B. there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Could this be a battle between two heirs of legends? No… Today is a celebration of the two formidable racers on the track here and now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The race between Mr. C.B. and Sakura Chiyono O is about to begin!
